Question/Deficiency: The Company promotes a culture of security and has in place a robust Supply Chain Security Program
Recommended Action: Your Company must promote a culture of security and you must have a strong Supply Chain Security Program. Please confirm that you will work on a strong program for Supply Chain Security. Please explain how you will do this.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop a comprehensive written Supply Chain Security Program that addresses all C-TPAT requirements. Assign a dedicated security coordinator and establish regular security meetings with all departments.

Question/Deficiency: A representative from all relevant departments has been appointed to a cross functional team in support of a robust Company supply chain security program
Recommended Action: Please appoint a representative from all relevant supply chain departments to gain knowledge about C-TPAT and to help strengthen the supply chain security program.
Suggested Corrective Action: Create a cross-functional security team with representatives from operations logistics IT human resources and management. Meet quarterly to review security procedures and address emerging threats.

Question/Deficiency: The Company's Supply Chain Security Program is designed with supported by and implemented by an appropriate written review component that holds personnel accountable for their responsibilities
Recommended Action: Your Company's Supply Chain Security Program must be designed supported by and implemented by an appropriate written review component which will hold personnel accountable for their responsibilities in the supply chain.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement annual security performance reviews for all personnel with supply chain responsibilities. Include security metrics in job descriptions and performance evaluations.

Question/Deficiency: The Company's points of contact (POC) to the Importer of Records are all knowledgeable about C-TPAT Program requirements and provide upper management with regular updates on issues related to the program
Recommended Action: The Company's points of contact (POC) to the Importer of Records MUST BE all knowledgeable about the C-TPAT Program requirements and must always provide upper management with regular updates on issues related to the program.
Suggested Corrective Action: Ensure all POCs complete C-TPAT training and provide monthly written reports to upper management on security program status compliance issues and improvement recommendations.

Question/Deficiency: There is a process in place to determine any potential risks or where security vulnerabilities may exist within the Company's Supply Chain
Recommended Action: You must have a process in place to determine potential risks and security vulnerabilities within your supply chain. Please provide your written risk assessment procedure.
Suggested Corrective Action: Conduct comprehensive annual risk assessments covering all supply chain operations. Document vulnerabilities and implement mitigation strategies with assigned owners and timelines.

Question/Deficiency: Risk assessments are reviewed annually or more frequently as risk factors dictate
Recommended Action: You must review your company's Risk assessments annually or more frequently as risk factors dictate.
Suggested Corrective Action: Establish formal schedule for risk assessment reviews. Document all changes to risk profile and update security procedures accordingly. Consider quarterly reviews for high-risk operations.

Question/Deficiency: Process and procedures are in place to address management of crisis situations such as a security review/recovery plan a disaster recovery plan as well as business continuity and resumption plans
Recommended Action: Your company must have a Business Continuity Plan to address these issues.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop comprehensive crisis management procedures including incident response plans business continuity plans and disaster recovery procedures. Test plans annually and update based on lessons learned.

Question/Deficiency: The Company has a written risk based process for screening new business partners and for monitoring current partners
Recommended Action: Your Company must have a written risk based process for screening new business partners and for monitoring current partners.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement formal due diligence procedures for all new business partners including background checks financial reviews and security assessments. Conduct annual reviews of existing partners.

Question/Deficiency: The Company whenever outsourcing or contracting parts of its supply chain must advise U.S. Partner of 3rd party outsourcing so it can be vetted
Recommended Action: You must advise your business partner with any 3rd party outsourcing so that they can vet them.
Suggested Corrective Action: Establish formal notification procedures for all outsourcing arrangements. Provide partner details security certifications and risk assessments to U.S. partners before implementation.

Question/Deficiency: When the Company is advised by U.S. Business Partner of weaknesses identified they are addressed and corrected and implemented in a timely manner
Recommended Action: Your company must address and correct any identified weaknesses in a timely manner.
Suggested Corrective Action: Create formal corrective action procedures with defined timelines for addressing partner-identified weaknesses. Provide written responses and implementation evidence within 30 days.

Question/Deficiency: The business partner selection process includes investigating potential activities related to money laundering and terrorist funding
Recommended Action: The business partner selection process MUST include investigating potential activities related to money laundering and terrorist funding. Please provide document showing how your company is preventing money laundering and terrorist funding.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement enhanced due diligence procedures including sanctions list screening beneficial ownership verification and ongoing monitoring for suspicious activities. Document all screening activities.

Question/Deficiency: A process is in place to closely examine business partners to ensure sourced goods/services are not mined produced or manufactured wholly or in part with prohibited forms of labor
Recommended Action: Your company must have a process in place to closely examine your business partners. You must ensure that sourced goods/services are not mined produced or manufactured wholly or in part with prohibited forms of labor.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop supplier code of conduct prohibiting forced labor. Conduct on-site audits and require written certifications from all suppliers regarding labor practices. Implement corrective action procedures for violations.

Question/Deficiency: The Company has a comprehensive written cybersecurity procedure to protect all Information Technology (IT) Systems
Recommended Action: Your company MUST have a strong Cybersecurity Policy in place. Please explain to us what your Cybersecurity Policy will include. Please send us your document policy.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop comprehensive cybersecurity policy covering network security data protection access controls incident response and employee training. Review and update annually.

Question/Deficiency: All Company computers and systems are protected by software and/or hardware firewalls that detect and prevent attempted illicit intrusion alteration of data and unauthorized access to data
Recommended Action: Your Company computers and systems must be protected by software and/or hardware firewalls. Please explain below and tell us what you are doing to protect your computers in cybersecurity.
Suggested Corrective Action: Install enterprise-grade firewalls with intrusion detection and prevention systems. Configure automated monitoring and alerting for security events. Maintain current threat intelligence feeds.

Question/Deficiency: The Company's IT infrastructure and network systems are regularly tested for security
Recommended Action: Your company's IT infrastructure and network systems are required to be regularly tested for security. If vulnerabilities are found corrective actions are taken as soon as possible.
Suggested Corrective Action: Conduct quarterly vulnerability assessments and annual penetration testing. Implement formal patch management procedures with defined timelines for critical security updates.

Question/Deficiency: The Company has a system in place to identify unauthorized access of IT systems/data or abuse of policies and procedures
Recommended Action: You must have a system in place to identify unauthorized access of computer IT systems/data or abuse of policies and procedures. Please tell us how you will accomplish this going forward in your procedures.
Suggested Corrective Action: Deploy Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system to monitor all network activity. Implement user behavior analytics to detect anomalous access patterns and policy violations.

Question/Deficiency: Cybersecurity policies and procedures are reviewed annually or more frequently as risk or circumstances dictate
Recommended Action: Cybersecurity policies must be reviewed annually. Must also be updated more frequently as needed.
Suggested Corrective Action: Establish formal cybersecurity policy review schedule. Update policies based on threat landscape changes regulatory requirements and incident lessons learned.

Question/Deficiency: User access is restricted based upon job description or assigned duties and is reviewed on a regular basis
Recommended Action: User access MUST BE restricted based upon job description to ensure access to sensitive systems is based on job requirements.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement role-based access controls with principle of least privilege. Conduct quarterly access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions promptly.

Question/Deficiency: All of the Company IT systems are password protected with access granted to authorized users with individually assigned accounts
Recommended Action: Please ensure that all your Company IT systems are password protected with access granted to authorized users with individually assigned accounts. Passwords must be changed periodically.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement strong password policies requiring complex passwords changed every 90 days. Deploy multi-factor authentication for all administrative and remote access.

Question/Deficiency: If the Company has remote users that connect to their network they utilize secure technologies such as a Virtual Private Network (VPN)
Recommended Action: Do you have remote users? If yes they must use secure technologies such as a Virtual Private Network (VPN) when employees work outside the Company offices.
Suggested Corrective Action: Deploy enterprise VPN solution with strong encryption and multi-factor authentication. Monitor all remote access sessions and maintain connection logs.

Question/Deficiency: All media hardware or other IT equipment that contains sensitive information regarding import/export process is accounted for through regular inventories
Recommended Action: All IT equipment must be accounted for because it contains sensitive information regarding import/export processes. You must inventory your IT Equipment.
Suggested Corrective Action: Maintain comprehensive IT asset inventory with regular physical audits. Implement asset tracking system and secure disposal procedures for retired equipment.

Question/Deficiency: All conveyances and Instruments of International Traffic (IIT) are stored in a secure area to prevent unauthorized access
Recommended Action: IIT and Conveyances must be stored in secured areas. How will this be accomplished going forward to prevent access? Please explain.
Suggested Corrective Action: Designate secure storage areas with controlled access physical barriers and surveillance. Implement key control procedures and access logs for all IIT storage areas.

Question/Deficiency: The C-TPAT inspection process has written procedures for both security and agricultural inspections
Recommended Action: The C-TPAT inspection process MUST have written procedures in place for both security and agricultural inspections. Please describe your procedures below.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop comprehensive inspection procedures covering seven-point container inspections and agricultural contamination checks. Train all inspection personnel and maintain inspection records.

Question/Deficiency: A seven-point inspection process is conducted on all empty containers and unit load devices (ULDs) prior to loading
Recommended Action: You must have a 7 pt inspection process in place. We have attached a 9 point inspection for you to use. The 7 point inspection has added 2 extra inspections for visible pest inspection and sweeping/cleaning.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement mandatory seven-point inspection covering front wall left side right side floor ceiling/roof inside/outside doors and outside/undercarriage. Add agricultural inspection and cleaning steps.

Question/Deficiency: The storage of empty and full containers is separated to prevent unauthorized access and manipulation
Recommended Action: You must have separated storage for empty and full containers to prevent unauthorized access. Please explain how they are segregated and secured.
Suggested Corrective Action: Create physically separated storage areas for empty and loaded containers with distinct access controls. Implement different security procedures and monitoring for each area.

Question/Deficiency: Conveyances and IIT are equipped with external hardware that can reasonably withstand attempts to remove it
Recommended Action: IIT must be equipped with external hardware that can reasonably withstand attempts to remove it. Your station must comply with these guidelines.
Suggested Corrective Action: Ensure all IIT have tamper-resistant hardware including reinforced doors secure locking mechanisms and inspection points for detecting tampering before sealing.

Question/Deficiency: If a credible threat to the security of a shipment or conveyance is discovered the Company has a process in place to alert business partners and law enforcement
Recommended Action: Supply chain security is everyone's responsibility. We need to be sure that all our business partners understand that we must be contacted if there is a potential breach in the supply chain.
Suggested Corrective Action: Establish immediate notification procedures for security threats including contact information for all supply chain partners and law enforcement agencies. Test communication procedures regularly.

Question/Deficiency: Written procedures stipulate how seals are to be controlled and affixed to loaded containers or trailers
Recommended Action: You must have written procedures that stipulate how seals are controlled and affixed. Please provide the written procedures.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop comprehensive seal control procedures covering seal procurement storage issuance application and verification. Include training requirements for authorized personnel.

Question/Deficiency: All loaded containers bound for the U.S. must be secured with a high-security seal that meets or exceeds ISO 17712 standards
Recommended Action: You must secure all loaded U.S.-bound containers with a high-security seal that meets or exceeds ISO 17712 standards. Please confirm this is your practice.
Suggested Corrective Action: Source ISO 17712 compliant high-security seals from approved suppliers. Maintain certificates of compliance and train personnel on proper application and verification procedures.

Question/Deficiency: There is a documented seal log to record seal numbers container numbers and usage
Recommended Action: You must have a documented seal log to record seal numbers container numbers and usage. Please provide a copy of your seal log.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement comprehensive seal tracking system recording seal numbers container numbers application date personnel responsible and verification checkpoints throughout transit.

Question/Deficiency: Procedures are in place to verify the physical integrity of the seal on all loaded trailers and containers
Recommended Action: You must have procedures in place to verify the physical integrity of the seal on all loaded trailers and containers. Please provide this procedure.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement VVTT (View Verify Tug Twist) procedures for all seal inspections. Train personnel to identify signs of tampering and document all seal verification activities.

Question/Deficiency: Procedures require that any compromised seals are reported to US Customs and Border Protection or the appropriate foreign authority
Recommended Action: You must have procedures requiring that any compromised seals are reported to CBP or the appropriate foreign authority. Please provide this procedure.
Suggested Corrective Action: Establish immediate reporting procedures for compromised seals including contact information for CBP and foreign authorities. Document all incidents and follow-up actions taken.

Question/Deficiency: All cargo staged overnight or for an extended period of time is secured from unauthorized access
Recommended Action: You must ensure all cargo staged overnight or for an extended period is secured from unauthorized access. Please explain the procedures.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement enhanced security measures for staged cargo including physical barriers surveillance systems access controls and regular security patrols.

Question/Deficiency: Procedures are in place to ensure that all information used in the clearing of merchandise/cargo is legible complete accurate and protected
Recommended Action: You must have procedures in place to ensure all information used for clearing cargo is legible complete accurate and protected. Please provide the procedures.
Suggested Corrective Action: Establish document control procedures including verification checks secure storage systems backup procedures and access controls for all cargo clearance documentation.

Question/Deficiency: Arriving cargo is reconciled against the cargo manifest
Recommended Action: You must reconcile arriving cargo against the cargo manifest. Please provide the written procedure for this reconciliation.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement mandatory cargo reconciliation procedures comparing physical cargo against manifests. Document all discrepancies and investigation procedures for resolving variances.

Question/Deficiency: Procedures are in place for reporting any cargo overages/shortages to the business partner and appropriate law enforcement agencies
Recommended Action: You must have procedures in place for reporting any cargo overages/shortages to the business partner and appropriate law enforcement. Please provide this procedure.
Suggested Corrective Action: Establish formal reporting procedures for cargo discrepancies including notification timelines contact information and documentation requirements for partners and law enforcement.

Question/Deficiency: Notification procedures include the accurate contact information that lists the name(s) and phone number(s) of personnel requiring notification as well as appropriate law enforcement agencies
Recommended Action: You must have notification procedures in place. It must include the accurate contact information that lists the name(s) and phone number(s) of personnel requiring notification as well as appropriate law enforcement agencies.
Suggested Corrective Action: Maintain current emergency contact lists including 24/7 contact information for key personnel business partners and law enforcement agencies. Update and test quarterly.

Question/Deficiency: The Company initiates their own internal investigations of any security related incidents immediately after becoming aware of any security related incident
Recommended Action: You must have procedures to initiate your own internal investigations of any security-related incidents immediately after becoming aware of them. Please provide this procedure.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop formal incident investigation procedures including immediate response steps evidence preservation witness interviews and corrective action implementation. Train investigation team members.

Question/Deficiency: There is a procedure in place to test the Company's supply chain security procedures on a regular basis
Recommended Action: You must have a procedure in place to test your company's supply chain security procedures on a regular basis. Please provide the procedure and evidence of the last test.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement annual security procedure testing including tabletop exercises physical security tests and procedure walkthroughs. Document results and implement improvements.

Question/Deficiency: There are processes and procedures in place designed to prevent visible contamination including compliance with Solid Wood Packaging Materials (ISPM-15)
Recommended Action: You must have processes and procedures in place to prevent visible contamination including compliance with ISPM-15. Please provide these procedures.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement comprehensive pest prevention program including facility cleanliness container cleaning inspection procedures and ISPM-15 compliance for wood packaging materials.

Question/Deficiency: All cargo handling and storage facilities have physical barriers and/or deterrents that prevent unauthorized access
Recommended Action: You must have physical barriers and/or deterrents at all cargo handling and storage facilities to prevent unauthorized access. Please describe them.
Suggested Corrective Action: Install perimeter fencing access control systems surveillance cameras adequate lighting and intrusion detection systems for all cargo handling and storage areas.

Question/Deficiency: Fencing or other barriers enclose the areas around cargo handling and storage facilities
Recommended Action: You must have fencing or other barriers that enclose the areas around cargo handling and storage facilities. Please describe them.
Suggested Corrective Action: Install minimum 8-foot perimeter fencing with anti-climb features controlled access gates and regular integrity inspections. Consider additional barriers for high-risk areas.

Question/Deficiency: Gates are manned or monitored to control the entry and exit of vehicles and personnel
Recommended Action: You must ensure gates are manned or monitored to control the entry and exit of vehicles and personnel. Please explain how this is done.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement gate control procedures with security personnel or electronic monitoring systems. Maintain access logs and verify authorization for all entries and exits.

Question/Deficiency: There is adequate lighting provided inside and outside the facility
Recommended Action: You must have adequate lighting inside and outside the facility. Please confirm its coverage.
Suggested Corrective Action: Install comprehensive lighting system covering all cargo areas perimeters parking areas and access points. Include emergency lighting and regular maintenance procedures.

Question/Deficiency: A Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) system is used to monitor the premises and prevent unauthorized access to cargo handling and storage areas
Recommended Action: You must use a CCTV system to monitor the premises and prevent unauthorized access. Please provide details about your CCTV system.
Suggested Corrective Action: Deploy comprehensive CCTV system with 24/7 recording capability covering all critical areas. Include monitoring procedures recording retention policies and regular system maintenance.

Question/Deficiency: There are alarm systems and security personnel that can respond to a security breach
Recommended Action: You must have alarm systems and security personnel that can respond to a security breach. Please describe your alarm systems and response procedures.
Suggested Corrective Action: Install intrusion detection systems connected to monitoring center with defined response procedures. Ensure security personnel or response service can react within defined timeframes.

Question/Deficiency: A personnel identification process/system is in place for positive identification and access control purposes
Recommended Action: You must have a personnel identification process/system in place for positive identification and access control. Please describe the system.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement comprehensive access control system using photo identification badges electronic access controls and visitor management procedures with regular access reviews.

Question/Deficiency: All visitors and vendors are required to present photo identification upon arrival and are escorted
Recommended Action: You must have a procedure requiring all visitors and vendors to present photo ID upon arrival and be escorted. Please provide this procedure.
Suggested Corrective Action: Establish formal visitor management procedures requiring photo ID verification temporary badge issuance escort assignments and visitor log maintenance with departure verification.

Question/Deficiency: A visitor log is maintained to record the details of all visitors
Recommended Action: You must maintain a visitor log to record the details of all visitors. Please provide a copy of your log template.
Suggested Corrective Action: Maintain comprehensive visitor log recording date time visitor name company ID type escort assigned areas accessed and departure time. Review logs regularly for security purposes.

Question/Deficiency: Procedures are in place to remove identification facility and system access for terminated employees
Recommended Action: You must have procedures in place to remove identification facility and system access for terminated employees. Please provide a copy of this procedure.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement formal access termination procedures including badge collection system access removal key retrieval and confirmation of termination completion. Execute immediately upon separation.

Question/Deficiency: Written processes are in place to screen prospective employees
Recommended Action: You must have written processes in place to screen prospective employees. Please provide these written processes.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop comprehensive employee screening procedures including background checks employment verification reference checks and ongoing monitoring for sensitive positions.

Question/Deficiency: Background checks are conducted on all prospective employees
Recommended Action: You must conduct background checks on all prospective employees in accordance with local regulations. Please confirm this is your procedure.
Suggested Corrective Action: Implement thorough background screening including criminal history employment verification education confirmation and reference checks within legal requirements of local jurisdiction.

Question/Deficiency: A security training and awareness program exists to recognize and foster awareness of security vulnerabilities
Recommended Action: You must have a security training and awareness program to recognize and foster awareness of security vulnerabilities. Please provide evidence of this program.
Suggested Corrective Action: Develop comprehensive security awareness training covering C-TPAT requirements threat recognition incident reporting and individual responsibilities. Conduct annual training with documented attendance.
